rows.quantity: installed power, sea-level climb 1,000 ft/min
rows.source: Mattingly (2.11) p. 24 with T = 550 eta_p P/V (shaft_power_loading); eta_p from the App. L actuator disk at the thrust of each condition, as Stage 1
rows.note: CD0 at sea level from the record; minimum over speed from 1.2 V_stall. Same inputs and an algebraically equal formula as Stage 1: a coding check.

rows.quantity: installed power, 100 ft/min at the ceiling altitude 23000 ft
rows.source: Mattingly (2.11) p. 24 with T = 550 eta_p P/V (shaft_power_loading); eta_p from the App. L actuator disk at the thrust of each condition, as Stage 1
rows.note: CD0 at the climb-speed floor and the App. K lapse there are recomputed with conceptual code (not in the record); the lapse is the engine table's, an input shared with Stage 1. Spec 7.1b declares the rows that use the engine table not independent: reported, not judged.

rows.quantity: installed power, take-off over 50 ft in the field length
rows.note: Inputs: field length 2500 ft, obstacle 50 ft, W0 and S from the record, take-off CD0 (clean + gear + take-off flap) from the rebuilt Stage 1 state, K from the record, take-off CL_max 1.818, rolling mu 0.03 and ground CL 0.1 from the ledger, thrust from the same propeller thrust function Stage 1 used (shaft power, eta_p, static-thrust cap; a shared input), evaluated at 0.7 V_TO for the roll (Anderson's rule, p. 360; Mattingly states no speed). Differences from Stage 1: k_TO 1.2 (the book's value, p. 43; at 1.1 the factor 0.8 k^2 - 1 of (2.27) is negative) against Stage 1's V_TO = 1.1 V_stall, rotation time 1 s as Stage 1 (the book 'normally' uses 3 s), transition arc at n = 0.8 k_TO^2 against Raymer's 1.15 V_stall arc. Only the take-off weight's field-length use is checked, not the take-off fuel.

rows.quantity: installed power, sustained 30 deg turn at loiter speed
rows.source: Mattingly (2.11) p. 24 with T = 550 eta_p P/V (shaft_power_loading); eta_p from the App. L actuator disk at the thrust of each condition, as Stage 1; n from (2.16) p. 27
rows.note: Loiter speed (Stage 1's best-endurance speed at W0 with the 1.3 V_stall floor) is recomputed with conceptual code; CD0 from the record. Same inputs and formula as Stage 1: a coding check.

rows.quantity: installed power, level cruise at mission altitude
rows.source: Mattingly (2.11) p. 24 with T = 550 eta_p P/V (shaft_power_loading); eta_p from the App. L actuator disk at the thrust of each condition, as Stage 1
rows.note: Cruise speed (Stage 1's best-range speed at W0) recomputed with conceptual code; CD0 from the record. Same inputs and formula as Stage 1: a coding check.

rows.quantity: mission fuel (200 nm out + 8 h + 200 nm back, headwind)
rows.note: Same speeds, SFC and headwind air distance as Stage 1; the fraction relations reduce algebraically to Raymer's, so this checks the coding. Take-off, landing and the 1.06 reserve are Stage 1's. Spec 7.1b declares the rows that use the engine table not independent: reported, not judged.

rows.quantity: take-off weight, Anderson first estimate (empty fraction 0.62)
rows.note: Anderson's own best-range and best-endurance speeds and (L/D)max (no 1.3 V_stall floor, headwind applied to the air distance at his best-range speed); polar, SFC used, eta_p, radius, headwind, loiter time and W/S from the record or its ledger copy. The empty fraction is Anderson's own; the fuel fraction rests on his relations with Stage 1's polar, SFC and eta_p.

rows.quantity: take-off weight, Anderson build-up (8.83) (same-author cross-check)
rows.note: Raymer's Table 15.2 approximate method, so not independent: reported, not judged (spec 7.1a). Uses the first-estimate fuel fraction.

rows.quantity: zero-lift drag coefficient, mission altitude, clean
rows.source: Anderson (2.37) p. 128 with Cfe 0.0043 of his propeller airplane, (8.40) p. 414
rows.note: S_wet from the rebuilt geometry (wing, fuselage, tails, sponsons); Cfe = 0.0043, the value Anderson uses for his propeller airplane (owner ruling G-3). The jet-aircraft curve of Fig. 2.55 (1.5 x flat plate, p. 129) gives Cfe 0.00312 and CD0 0.01459, shown alongside in the detail. The method resolves CD0 to about +-20 %: the coefficient is a book value, not a measurement of this airframe.

rows.quantity: propeller efficiency, climb (sea level, full power)
rows.source: Mattingly App. L (L.7)-(L.9) p. 612 actuator disk, real-to-ideal 0.85
rows.note: Coding check, not independent: Stage 1 is on the same App. L actuator disk with the same factor (0.85, ledger prop_real_to_ideal), so this row re-codes (L.7)-(L.9) in measurement/mattingly.py against conceptual/raymer_propulsion.py and agreement cannot confirm the physics. With the blade-element check waived (owner ruling G-5) no independent propeller check is left. Shaft 450.0 hp at 99.2 kt, diameter 6.91 ft, thrust 1,064 lb. The 0.85 factor is the book's typical value, applied to every point; no blade-element or propeller-map estimate was made (owner ruling G-5: waived before Gate B, listed as open). The shaft powers are Stage 1's, found from the same disk, so the thrust used here is the drag.

rows.quantity: propeller efficiency, cruise (outbound leg)
rows.source: Mattingly App. L (L.7)-(L.9) p. 612 actuator disk, real-to-ideal 0.85
rows.note: Coding check, not independent: Stage 1 is on the same App. L actuator disk with the same factor (0.85, ledger prop_real_to_ideal), so this row re-codes (L.7)-(L.9) in measurement/mattingly.py against conceptual/raymer_propulsion.py and agreement cannot confirm the physics. With the blade-element check waived (owner ruling G-5) no independent propeller check is left. Shaft 132.5 hp at 141.2 kt, diameter 6.91 ft, thrust 249 lb. The 0.85 factor is the book's typical value, applied to every point; no blade-element or propeller-map estimate was made (owner ruling G-5: waived before Gate B, listed as open). The shaft powers are Stage 1's, found from the same disk, so the thrust used here is the drag.

rows.quantity: propeller efficiency, loiter
rows.source: Mattingly App. L (L.7)-(L.9) p. 612 actuator disk, real-to-ideal 0.85
rows.note: Coding check, not independent: Stage 1 is on the same App. L actuator disk with the same factor (0.85, ledger prop_real_to_ideal), so this row re-codes (L.7)-(L.9) in measurement/mattingly.py against conceptual/raymer_propulsion.py and agreement cannot confirm the physics. With the blade-element check waived (owner ruling G-5) no independent propeller check is left. Shaft 84.4 hp at 96.9 kt, diameter 6.91 ft, thrust 223 lb. The 0.85 factor is the book's typical value, applied to every point; no blade-element or propeller-map estimate was made (owner ruling G-5: waived before Gate B, listed as open). The shaft powers are Stage 1's, found from the same disk, so the thrust used here is the drag.

rows.quantity: best-range speed (L/D max), mission altitude
rows.stage1_source: recomputed with conceptual code from the record's inputs
rows.note: Stage 1 value: Raymer's closed form (17.2, p. 457-459) at W0, mission altitude and the record's CD0 there (recomputed, not in the record). The mission itself flew other speeds (engine-table SFC, headwind, 1.3 V_stall floor).

rows.quantity: best-endurance speed (C_L^1.5/C_D max), mission altitude
rows.stage1_source: recomputed with conceptual code from the record's inputs
rows.note: Stage 1 value: Raymer's closed form (17.2, p. 457-459) at W0, mission altitude and the record's CD0 there (recomputed, not in the record). The mission itself flew other speeds (engine-table SFC, headwind, 1.3 V_stall floor).

rows.quantity: sea-level rate of climb at W0
rows.source: Anderson (5.121) p. 277 (5.122 misprinted, per the notes)
rows.note: Rated 450 hp at sea level, eta_p 0.7195 (App. L disk at full power at Stage 1's best-climb speed 99.0 kt; at the closed form's own best-climb speed 64.6 kt it would be 0.5902, which a constant eta cannot follow), CD0 at sea level from the record, as Stage 1. Same inputs, closed form against a numerical search: a coding check.

rows.quantity: best-climb speed, sea level
rows.note: Stage 1 searches speeds from 1.2 V_stall upward (Raymer p. 489) and lands on that floor; the closed form has no floor. Same polar and power: the difference is a modelling choice (the floor), not a second source.

rows.quantity: service ceiling (100 ft/min) at W0
rows.source: Anderson (5.121) p. 277 with the App. K lapse
rows.note: Same engine table as Stage 1 (shared input); CD0 recomputed per altitude; the closed form has no 1.2 V_stall floor, Stage 1 does. Spec 7.1b declares the rows that use the engine table not independent: reported, not judged.

rows.quantity: take-off distance over 50 ft, sea level
rows.note: Ground roll 406 ft (with N = 1 s rotation, V_LO = 1.1 V_stall, thrust at 0.7 V_LO from the shared propeller thrust function) plus airborne 397 ft (n = 1.19 arc). Stage 1 (Raymer 17.8): 312 ft roll, 95 rotation, 387 airborne. Inputs as listed in field_rows: W0, S, K, take-off CD0, take-off CL_max, rolling mu, ground CL (ledger). Different ground-roll and airborne relations, shared thrust function, CD0 and CL_max.

rows.quantity: landing distance over 50 ft, sea level
rows.note: Approach+flare 993 ft (3 deg approach, flare at 1.23 V_stall), ground roll incl. 2 s free roll 433 ft (V_TD 1.15 V_stall, braking mu 0.5, idle thrust zero). Inputs: W0, S, K, landing CD0, landing CL_max, braking mu, ground CL, free-roll time (ledger). Anderson's approach and flare relations are the same speeds and geometry as Raymer's, so this is a coding and arithmetic cross-check on those segments; the braking roll has its own relation.

rows.quantity: corner speed V*, sea level, EAS
rows.note: n_limit (3.8, the requirement) and clean CL_max 1.35 from the record. The same V = sqrt(2 n W/S/(rho CL_max)) as Stage 1's, so it checks the arithmetic.

rows.quantity: gust load factors (V_C and V_D points)
rows.note: not computed: Anderson's chapter 6 has no gust load factor relation (the V-n section 6.5, p. 341-344, only names gusts as the reason for the red-line speed limit; searched the library notes for 'gust'). Raymer (14.x) is Stage 1's own source, so using it here would not be independent and is not substituted; a second source (Mattingly has none) is needed. Owner ruling G-5: waived before Gate B, listed as open.

mission_legs.basis: Mattingly (3.17)/(3.20); best-climb speed, D/T, SFC as Stage 1 formed them
